project_context.name: NoSolo
project_context.target_audience: Backpackers, digital nomads, students, female solo travelers

headings.usage: H1-H4 must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight). Do not use generic fonts like Inter.

body.usage: Use for all body text, form inputs, and admin data tables. Ensure high readability.

rules: Never use pure black or gray; always tint darks with Navy (#0A192F).
Ensure text over images has contrast (use text-shadow or gradient overlay max bg-black/40).
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for headers or overlays.

marketing_landing.hero: Immersive full-screen or 80vh layout with background image. Left-aligned typography. Use max overlay bg-black/40. Let the image breathe.
marketing_landing.features: Mode A: 'Tetris' Bento Grid. Asymmetrical spans (col-span-8, col-span-4). Wide gaps (gap-8).
marketing_landing.spacing: Generous spacing. py-24 or py-32 for sections.

admin_dashboard.layout: High Density Grid. Sharp edges or max 8px border-radius.
admin_dashboard.table: Dense padding, 1px subtle border, clear columns for Feedback/Support data.
admin_dashboard.spacing: Tight gaps (gap-4). Full screen height utilization.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or slightly rounded (rounded-lg). Smooth hover transitions with color shifts.
components.cards: Subtle 1px border. Do not overuse drop shadows. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1).
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form components. Thick inputs (h-12). Clearly visible focus states (ring-2 ring-sky-500).
components.navigation: Sticky header MUST have Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 or bg-[#0A192F]/80). No transparent headers.
components.toasts: Use Sonner for all form submission feedback. Implement in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js.
components.admin_login: Simple centered card modal with password input and submit button.

rules: Use framer-motion for subtle entrance animations (fade up, stagger children).
No 'transition: all'. Explicitly define transitions (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).
Hover states must always shift color and optionally lift.

test_ids: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
Examples: data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='feedback-form-submit', data-testid='admin-password-input', data-testid='admin-table-row', data-testid='close-ticket-btn'.
accessibility.contrast: Maintain 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Use dark text on light backgrounds.

hero_background.description: Woman with a backpack enjoying a peaceful walk on a forest boardwalk at sunset. Represents solo travel.

about_section.description: Woman working on a laptop outside a cafe. Vibe for digital nomads.

abstract_texture.description: Topographic map texture for background elements or features section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build out the static site using React (.js files, NOT .tsx), Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI.
Implement Firebase Hosting and Firestore configuration (use stubs for now).
Create the Landing Page with Hero, Features (bento grid), Safety, About, and CTA to forms.
Create Reusable Form component for both Feedback and Support with Shadcn form + sonner toast.
Create Admin '/support' page: gated by password 'Nosolo!23'. Use a Shadcn Table with badges for priority and status.
Implement 'Mark as Closed' and 'Delete' functionalities for tickets (stubbed or functional via Firebase).
Enforce all UI/UX rules: use data-testid on every button/input, do NOT use default generic fonts like Inter, do not center text globally, use provided Unsplash/Pexels image URLs.
Use framer-motion for smooth staggered page loads.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
